details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: peer-supplied --backup-dir and --partial-dir escape
     the daemon module
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70460.patch: track the resolved path in the
       ownership walk and refuse any component that leaves the module root,
       and route make_backup() and the --inplace backup (link, rename, copy,
       mkdir, mknod, symlink and attribute updates) and the --partial-dir
       handling (basis stat, open and unlink, in-place staging, delayed
       rename, partial-dir create and remove) through that walk, so an
       in-module symlink cannot redirect an absolute --backup-dir or
       --partial-dir outside a "use chroot = no" module
     - CVE-2026-70460
